[SWS_V2xFac_00141]
⌈The
function
V2xFac_V2xM_CommitPseudonymChange
shall set the pseudonym specific part of the GeoNetworking Address being used for
packet transmission and clean the path history. V2xFac shall store the access of the
GeoNetworking Address for subsequent API calls.⌋
